claims: There was no official crewed mission named Apollo 2.
The Apollo 1 mission fire occurred in 1967.
NASA renamed the planned second mission following the Apollo 1 mission fire.
NASA reorganized the program following the Apollo 1 mission fire.
The Apollo 1 crew consisted of Grissom, White, Chaffee.
The Apollo 1 crew was the last to hold that specific, numerical designation.
AS-202 was often informally referred to as Apollo 2.
AS-202 was the second uncrewed suborbital test flight of the Apollo Command and Service Module (Block I).
AS-202 used a Saturn IB rocket.
AS-203 tested the behavior of liquid hydrogen in the Saturn IB's S-IVB stage in orbit.
Apollo 7 was the first crewed mission.
The crew originally intended for the second Apollo flight was eventually assigned to Apollo 7 after the program pause.
FreeRider Apollo II Power Wheelchair is an electric mobility aid.
Apollo Phantom 2.0 Electric Scooter is a high-performance electric scooter.
Ambiq Apollo2 SoC is an ultra-low power System on a Chip for portable devices.
